definitions.explanation: Overly serious and rule-bound, with no flexibility or humor; said of a person, an attitude or a speech. Mildly critical.

examples.japanese: {四角四面|しかくしめん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{四角四面|しかくしめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えなくて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You don't have to think about it so rigidly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四角四面|しかくしめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{硬|かた}く→硬い：01116_katai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: His speech was so stiff and formal that the room grew a little tense.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound, literally "four corners, four sides": a perfect square.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四角四面|しかくしめん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a stiff, strait-laced person
- {四角四面|しかくしめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think rigidly
- {四角四面|しかくしめん}な⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: a stiff, formal speech

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{堅苦|かたくる}しい→堅苦しい：25258_katakurushii⟧: stiff, formal; usually of an atmosphere or occasion rather than a person's character
- {杓子定規|しゃくしじょうぎ}: applying a rule mechanically to every case
